title: Theme brief date-object file
description: One object on one calendar date (Asia/Shanghai). A file may contain one or more slots (08:45, 17:45).

id.description: Object id, must match the filename (without .json) and an id in objects.json.

date.description: Calendar date in Asia/Shanghai, must match the parent folder name.

slot.description: Brief slot time in Asia/Shanghai, usually 08:45 or 17:45.

important.description: True only for material developments that day (new official warning, official data release, completed swearing-in, registration amendment filed, independent counsel hired). Routine 'no new window / prices still moving' should be false.

headline.description: Short Chinese headline. Shown in red when important is true.

x_circulation.description: What circulated on X, in plain Chinese. Empty string if the brief did not mention X for this object.

public_record.description: What the public record says, faithful to the delivered digest. Plain Chinese. May use Markdown links for arXiv.

sources.description: Named sources from the digest only. Do not invent.

still_unseen.description: Items the brief explicitly said were not seen in that slot.

important_points.description: A few short factual sentences to mark in red. Empty if nothing should be highlighted. Do not paste the whole body.
